accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:conditional-extid-completeness

Turn the three-node audit into a genuine symbolic certificate: specify a real-closed-field parameterization of q_S and q_0, the quantified formula, and the finite CAD/QE output that partitions the compatible image; include the first rational G_star witness or a certified impossibility result.
